title: Estimation and Whole-Curve Inference for Proxy-Based Quantile Treatment Effect Sensitivity Intervals
banked_reason: Field-tier endpoint inference did not close: continuous sharp-endpoint sieve recovery, growing-dimensional projection differentiation, and conditional multiplier validity remain unproved; only letter-tier confidence-region inversion is sound under frozen assumptions.
gap_reasons: The proposed finite-sample result is only the generic confidence-region union implication P in C_n implies I_Delta(P,eta) is contained in the union; it has neither sharp endpoint inference, an attaining estimator, a matching limit law, nor a demonstrated strict/first-result comparison, so the Stat contribution is below the field floor.
The recovery lemma controls deterministic centering but does not imply local prox-regularity or active-set stability of the finite-sieve projection.

The base directional derivative remains unresolved. Even with independent Rademacher multipliers, the present assumptions do not establish stochastic equicontinuity of the growing estimated derivative class or conditional convergence of the supremum functional.
proof_attempt_summary: D-0.5 accepted a field-tier endpoint-inference proposal after four angle pivots. D0 established population and finite-program attainment but could not prove continuous sharp-endpoint sieve recovery, a growing-dimensional directional limit, or multiplier validity under the frozen assumptions. The only sound replacement was confidence-region inversion, rated letter tier in angle 3; the unsupported D0 theorem graph is an attempt record, not a verified result.
tldr: The proposal makes the feasible total-variation proxy-QTE sensitivity interval estimable rather than merely identified. At resolution \(B\), the observed input is an explicitly ordered \((12B+24)\)-vector of categorical cells and grid subdistributions, projected with a regularized positive-definite estimated weight and a measurable lexicographic global-minimizer rule. A finite linear-spline program has explicit latent probabilities, proxy cells, outcome-density coefficients, total-variation constraints, sign-invariant projector residuals, and lower or upper QTE objectives. Conditional on a nonempty completion correspondence, population extrema are attained, outward-rounded branch-and-bound gaps certify the nonconvex projection and endpoint solves, and the plug-in estimators have a joint directional root-\(n\) limit under explicit local completion-level KKT regularity. Empty fibers produce an infeasibility report, not endpoint values. A moment-and-weight numerical-delta multiplier scheme delivers simultaneous bands without relying on the generally invalid naive bootstrap. A fully normalized smooth witness yields a nonempty open feasible class on which the interval strictly tightens the logical \([-1,1]\) QTE bound.
gap: Existing data-fusion QTE work gives point-estimator asymptotic normality, long-term fusion work targets means, and proxy partial-identification work supplies different bounds or computation. None provides an attaining continuous-outcome completion estimator, its exact directional law, and valid whole-curve resampling for sharp total-variation latent-proxy QTE endpoints.
fill: The project supplies an explicitly ordered finite moment embedding, a regularized estimated weight, measurable global projection, globally certified spline endpoint programs, a population-to-sieve error bound, joint moment-and-weight directional derivatives, numerical-delta multiplier validity, and a strict logical-bound comparison on a fully specified open witness class.
